meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在构建 HyperFrames 项目时会遵循这份技术契约：用带 data-* 时间属性的 HTML 写出可渲染组合，并遵守轨道、子组合、变量、媒体播放与确定性渲染等规则。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 HyperFrames 创建视频组合、编写组合 HTML，或提到时间属性、轨道、子组合等主题时触发。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude follows the HyperFrames technical contract when building a project: it writes renderable composition HTML with data-* timing attributes, and obeys rules for tracks, sub-compositions, variables, media playback, and deterministic rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write HyperFrames composition HTML, create a video composition, or mentions topics like data-* timing attributes, tracks, or sub-compositions.

say_en.note: Claude scaffolds the HTML with data-* timing attributes per the contract.
